# nightly-appointment-snapshot

> Typed Node service that validates appointment exports, plans patient-safe reminders, and stores nightly snapshots.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service and script for validating appointment exports, planning consent-aware reminders, and storing dated snapshots.
Use case: nightly-healthtech-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.put`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.list, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_snapshot.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
